judged_text: The controller enqueues a RetrieveTopic job on every request where no topic exists yet; the 60-second throttle lives inside the job, not at enqueue time. A heavily-viewed embedding page that fails to import (invalid host, feed disabled, embed_by_username unset) enqueues one Sidekiq job per page view forever — thousands of no-op jobs that each burn a Redis throttle check — a queue-flooding path with no enqueue-side guard.

record.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The controller enqueues a RetrieveTopic job on every request where no topic exists yet; the 60-second throttle lives inside the job, not at enqueue time. A heavily-viewed embedding page that fails to import (invalid host, feed disabled, embed_by_username unset) enqueues one Sidekiq job per page view forever — thousands of no-op jobs that each burn a Redis throttle check — a queue-flooding path with no enqueue-side guard.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil, it unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading` (no enqueue-side throttling/guard). The only throttle is inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`, which runs when the job executes (via `Jobs::RetrieveTopic#execute` -> `TopicRetriever#retrieve`), so a high-traffic embed URL with no existing TopicEmbed will enqueue one Sidekiq job per page view. Even if `TopicRetriever` quickly bails (e.g., because it was recently retrieved) it still consumes a job slot and does Redis ops; and if `embed_by_username` is unset, `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` calls `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` which can error, further compounding queue churn. This is a diff-grounded queue-flooding/DoS path.
